topics.title: What Is Linux?
topics.description: What Linux is: kernel vs distribution, open source, distributions (Ubuntu, Debian, RHEL), where Linux runs and why developers need it.

topics.title: Linux Architecture
topics.description: Hardware, kernel, system calls and user space; kernel responsibilities, the boot process, init and systemd, and kernel vs user mode.

topics.title: Shell, Terminal and Bash
topics.description: Terminal vs shell vs console, bash and other shells, the prompt, command syntax, history, tab completion and essential keyboard shortcuts.

topics.title: Linux Practice Lab
topics.description: Set up the safe ~/linux-lab practice folder with sample logs, CSV data and a Java project, used by every runnable example in the Linux topics.

topics.title: The Linux Filesystem Hierarchy
topics.description: The single directory tree from /: /etc, /var, /home, /usr, /tmp, /dev, /proc and more, "everything is a file", and file types.

topics.title: Paths and Navigation
topics.description: Absolute and relative paths, ., .., ~ and -, how paths are resolved, pwd, cd, and ls with its key options and long-listing format.

topics.title: Creating, Copying, Moving and Deleting Files
topics.description: mkdir, touch, cp, mv, rm, rmdir and ln with their important options, safe deletion habits, and the dangers of rm -rf.

topics.title: Viewing Files: cat, less, head, tail, file and stat
topics.description: cat, less, more, head, tail (and tail -f), file and stat: reading files of any size, following logs and inspecting metadata.

topics.title: Getting Help and Finding Commands
topics.description: man pages and sections, --help, help, type, which, whereis, apropos and history: finding out what a command is and how to use it.

topics.title: Standard Streams and Redirection
topics.description: stdin, stdout and stderr, file descriptors, >, >>, 2>, 2>&1, &>, /dev/null, input redirection, here-documents and noclobber.

topics.title: Pipes and Command Chaining
topics.description: Pipes and pipelines, exit statuses, &&, || and ;, subshells and grouping, command substitution, and PIPESTATUS/pipefail.

topics.title: grep: Searching Text
topics.description: grep for searching text: -i, -v, -n, -c, -w, -o, -r, -l, context lines, basic vs extended regular expressions and fixed strings.

topics.title: sort, uniq and wc
topics.description: sort (numeric, reverse, by key, unique, human sizes), uniq with counts and why it needs sorted input, and wc for counting.

topics.title: cut, tr and paste
topics.description: Extracting columns with cut, translating and deleting characters with tr, and joining files side by side with paste.

topics.title: Comparing Files: diff and comm
topics.description: Comparing files with diff (normal and unified output), cmp, and comm for lines common to or unique in two sorted files.

topics.title: xargs and tee
topics.description: xargs to turn input into arguments (-n, -I, -0 with find -print0) and tee to save a pipeline's output while passing it on.

topics.title: File Permissions and chmod
topics.description: Read, write and execute for owner, group and others; ls -l, octal and symbolic chmod, directory permissions and safe recursive changes.

topics.title: Ownership: chown, chgrp and umask
topics.description: File owners and groups, chown and chgrp, how umask sets default permissions for new files and directories, and the check order.

topics.title: Special Permissions: SUID, SGID and the Sticky Bit
topics.description: SUID, SGID and the sticky bit: what they do on files and directories, how they appear in ls -l, real examples and security risks.

topics.title: Users, Groups and Account Files
topics.description: Users, UIDs, groups, primary and supplementary groups, /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow and /etc/group, id, whoami and system accounts.

topics.title: Managing Users and Groups
topics.description: useradd, adduser, usermod -aG, passwd, chage, userdel, groupadd and gpasswd, with safe workflows for managing accounts.

topics.title: su and sudo
topics.description: Becoming root safely: su vs sudo, sudo -i and -u, the sudoers file and visudo, least privilege, and redirection pitfalls with sudo.

topics.title: Processes and the Process Lifecycle
topics.description: Programs vs processes, PID and PPID, fork and exec, process states, zombies and orphans, daemons, and the /proc filesystem.

topics.title: Monitoring Processes: ps, top, htop, pgrep and pidof
topics.description: ps aux and custom columns, top and htop, pgrep and pidof, load average, CPU and memory columns, and nice/renice priorities.

topics.title: Foreground, Background and Job Control
topics.description: Foreground and background jobs, &, jobs, fg, bg, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+C, nohup, disown and keeping work running after logout.

topics.title: Signals: kill, killall and pkill
topics.description: Signals and their defaults: SIGTERM vs SIGKILL, SIGHUP, SIGINT, SIGSTOP and SIGCONT; kill, killall, pkill and trap in scripts.

topics.title: Shell Variables, Environment Variables and PATH
topics.description: Shell vs environment variables, export, env and printenv, PATH and how commands are found, and common variables like HOME and USER.

topics.title: Quoting, Expansion and Globbing
topics.description: Single vs double quotes, escaping, word splitting, globbing, brace, tilde, parameter, arithmetic and command expansion and their order.

topics.title: Shell Startup Files, Aliases and Configuration
topics.description: Login vs interactive shells, ~/.bashrc, ~/.profile and /etc files, aliases, source, customising the prompt and persistent PATH.

topics.title: Bash Script Basics: Shebang, Arguments, read and Exit Codes
topics.description: Writing and running scripts: shebang, permissions, variables, arguments ($1, $#, "$@"), read, exit codes, and debugging with bash -x.

topics.title: Conditionals: if, test, [ ], [[ ]] and case
topics.description: if, elif, else, test and [ ], [[ ]] with pattern and regex matching, file tests, string and integer comparisons, (( )) and case.

topics.title: Loops: for, while, until, break and continue
topics.description: for over lists, globs and ranges, C-style for, while and until, reading files line by line, break and continue.

topics.title: Functions: Arguments, local, return and exit
topics.description: Defining functions, arguments, local variables, return vs exit, returning data with output, and organising scripts with functions.

topics.title: Practical Bash Scripts
topics.description: Complete scripts: log summary, department report, cleanup with a dry run, timestamped backups with rotation and a disk-space check.

topics.title: find: Searching for Files
topics.description: find by name, type, size, time, owner and permissions; combining tests, -exec and -delete safely, and pairing with xargs.

topics.title: sed: The Stream Editor
topics.description: sed substitution with flags and groups, addresses and ranges, printing and deleting lines, in-place editing with backups.

topics.title: awk: Fields, Patterns and Reports
topics.description: awk fields and separators, patterns and actions, NR and NF, BEGIN and END, sums, averages, grouping with arrays and formatted reports.

topics.title: Archives and Compression: tar, gzip and zip
topics.description: tar to create, list and extract archives, gzip, bzip2 and xz compression, zip and unzip, and safe extraction habits.

topics.title: Package Management with apt
topics.description: apt update vs upgrade, install, remove and purge, search and show, dpkg queries, repositories, and the RHEL dnf equivalents.

topics.title: Network Configuration: ip, Routes, Hostname and /etc/hosts
topics.description: Interfaces, IP addresses and CIDR, ip addr, ip link and ip route, the default gateway, hostname, /etc/hosts and legacy ifconfig.

topics.title: Connectivity and DNS: ping, traceroute, dig and nslookup
topics.description: ping, traceroute and tracepath for reachability, DNS resolution order, /etc/resolv.conf, and dig, nslookup, host and getent.

topics.title: Ports, Sockets and HTTP Tools: ss, netstat, nc, curl and wget
topics.description: Ports and sockets, listening addresses, ss and netstat, nc for port tests, curl for HTTP requests and debugging, and wget downloads.

topics.title: Disk Usage: df and du
topics.description: df for filesystem space and inodes, du for directory sizes, finding what fills a disk, and why df and du can disagree.

topics.title: Disks, Partitions, Filesystems and Mounting
topics.description: Disks, partitions and filesystems, lsblk and blkid, mount and umount, /etc/fstab with UUIDs, and the safety rules for mkfs and fdisk.

topics.title: Inodes, Hard Links and Symbolic Links
topics.description: Inodes and what they store, directories as name-to-inode tables, hard links vs symbolic links, link counts and broken links.

topics.title: systemd and Services: systemctl
topics.description: systemd units, systemctl start, stop, restart, reload, enable and status, writing a service unit, restart policies and failed units.

topics.title: Logs: /var/log, journalctl and Log Rotation
topics.description: Where logs live in /var/log, journalctl filters by unit, time, priority and boot, kernel logs, logger, and logrotate configuration.

topics.title: Cron and Scheduling
topics.description: Cron expressions, crontab -e, -l and -r, system crontabs, the cron environment pitfalls, flock, at, and systemd timers.

topics.title: SSH, Keys, scp and rsync
topics.description: SSH and key-based authentication, ssh-keygen, authorized_keys, known_hosts, ~/.ssh/config, scp, rsync, tunnels and sshd hardening.

topics.title: Troubleshooting: Disk Space, Files and Commands
topics.description: Step-by-step workflows for disk full, large files, growing logs, deleted-but-open files, undeletable files, permission denied and command not found.

topics.title: Troubleshooting: CPU, Memory, Services, Ports and Logs
topics.description: Workflows for high CPU, high memory and OOM kills, stubborn background processes, services that fail to start, port conflicts and recent logs.

topics.title: Troubleshooting: Network Connectivity and DNS
topics.description: Layer-by-layer connectivity troubleshooting, refused vs timed out, DNS failures with getent and dig, and services reachable only locally.

topics.title: Linux Fundamentals Interview Questions
topics.description: Interview bank on Linux basics: kernel and shell, filesystem hierarchy, paths, file commands, streams, pipes, system calls and what happens when you run a command.

topics.title: Permissions and Users Interview Questions
topics.description: Interview bank on permission bits, octal modes, directory permissions, umask, SUID/SGID/sticky, account files, groups, su, sudo and shared directories.

topics.title: Processes, Signals and Services Interview Questions
topics.description: Interview bank on processes, states, zombies and orphans, signals, job control, nohup, systemd services, logs and service restart loops.

topics.title: Shell and Bash Scripting Interview Questions
topics.description: Interview bank on Bash: variables, quoting, exit codes, $@ vs $*, set -euo pipefail, tests, loops, parameter expansion, traps and one-liners.

topics.title: Networking, Storage and Packages Interview Questions
topics.description: Interview bank on IP and DNS tools, ports, curl vs wget, scp vs rsync, df vs du, inodes, links, mounting, fstab, archives and apt.

topics.title: Scenario-Based Linux Interview Questions
topics.description: Scenario questions with model answers: disk full, website down, failing services, port conflicts, cron, slow servers, SSH lockouts and compromised hosts.

topics.title: Linux Interview Traps
topics.description: The misconceptions interviewers probe, each disproved with a runnable command: sort > same file, uniq, grep -c, 2>&1 order, subshells, quoting and more.
